## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem, its trigger, and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Include synthetic desktop/mobile screenshots
for UI changes and explain any checks that could not be completed.

## Compatibility and deployment

Mention migrations, configuration or provider changes, external data transfer,
new dependencies, and recovery steps when relevant. Otherwise write "Not applicable."

## Review checklist

- [ ] I read the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples match the final behavior.
- [ ] Behavior changes cover the affected journey and relevant independence,
      provenance, edit-preservation, and resume boundaries.
- [ ] UI changes were checked at desktop and mobile widths, including relevant
      empty, loading, degraded, error, and long-content states (or do not affect UI).
- [ ] This PR contains no secrets, private recording content, account identifiers,
      or signed download URLs.
